@: Work modes: the status bar chip, its quick menu and Settings > Performance (web/js/workmode.js).
mode.full_sub: Uses all the power it can get, even while you play.
mode.balanced_sub: Gives way to your game and OBS.
mode.background_sub: Works only while you're away from the PC.
help.full: Full speed: WardogClips uses all the power it can get, even while you play.
help.balanced: Balanced: WardogClips works at low priority and slows down further while a game, a full-screen app or an OBS recording is running.
help.background: Background: WardogClips starts new work only after you have been away from the PC for a while and nothing is running full screen.
@chip_tip_note: The chip's tooltip: the mode's help sentence followed by the reason it is slowed down.
explain: Gaming or streaming while WardogClips works will slow it down; it gives way to your game and OBS. Balanced runs at low priority and, while a game, a full-screen app or an OBS recording is running, starts fewer jobs at once and uses fewer CPU threads. Background only starts new work when you have been away from the PC for a while. Work that is already running is never thrown away: it finishes, and the next job waits.
sig.game_fullscreen: A game is running full screen.
sig.app_fullscreen: An app is running full screen.
sig.encoder: OBS (or another app) is recording or streaming.
menu.pause_sub: Running jobs finish; nothing new starts.
set.mode: How hard WardogClips works while you use the PC
set.auto_detect: Slow down while a game, a full-screen app or an OBS recording is running
set.idle_min: Background: start new work after this many minutes away from the PC
set.gpu_busy_pct: Graphics card load that counts as a game running (%)
